children: Oman’s total oil production rose 11.3 per cent by the end of July 2026 to 233.8 million barrels, up from 210.1 million barrels during the same period in 2025, according to preliminary data from the National Centre for Statistics and Information (NCSI).
The average oil price increased 15.7 per cent to $83.9 per barrel, compared with $72.5 a year earlier.
Average daily oil production also climbed 11.3 per cent to 1.103 million barrels per day, compared with 991,100 barrels per day in the corresponding period of 2025.
Meanwhile, Oman’s oil exports increased 1.8 per cent to 181.9 million barrels by the end of July, up from 178.7 million barrels during the same period last year.
